## What is happening
Nine suppliers are below the 96% target. Across all suppliers, recent PO-line DIFOT is 79.4%.

| Supplier | Recent DIFOT | Before | Driver | Whose problem |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Feeding Solutions | 68.4% | 76.9% | late | Supplier |
| Premium Brands AU | 71.4% | 76.5% | late and short | Supplier |
| Bugaboo Pacific | 72.3% | 71.9% | late | Supplier |
| Dorel Australia | 75.5% | 66.7% | late | Supplier |
| Rascal & Co | 79.5% | 95.5% | short | Supplier |
| Philips ANZ | 81.5% | 73.8% | late | Supplier |
| Britax Group | 84.6% | 81.0% | short | Supplier |
| **Kimberly-Clark ANZ** | **85.2%** | 86.1% | short | **Baby Mart** |
| Hanes Pacific | 86.4% | 87.9% | late | Supplier |

I tested Feeding Solutions (the worst) and Kimberly-Clark (the only one pointing at us) in detail. The other seven are labelled from the attribution in the supplier ranking only; I didn't run tests on them.

## Whose problem it is
- **Kimberly-Clark (mostly ours):**
  - **What drives the miss:** Short deliveries, not lateness. On-time is 96.3%, and 16 of 20 missed lines were short.
  - **The override:** Sam Patel (Demand Planning) entered overrides DOV-26-0415 to 0418 on 2 April for Huggies Crawler Nappies. They ramp from 1.35x to 2.2x ahead of the TV campaign, were due for review on 30 April, and are still **ACTIVE**.
  - **What the supplier shipped:** On the 6 cut lines, Kimberly-Clark delivered 99.9% of the order before the uplift was applied. In other words, it shipped its normal quantity.
  - **Scorecard:** Those misses hold 54.2% of the units short and shouldn't count against Kimberly-Clark.
- **Feeding Solutions (theirs):**
  - Only 5.6% of its misses trace to us.
  - 24.6% of its lines arrived late, by 25.2 days on average, on its 35-day sea and road lane from overseas.
  - A 3PL could land stock in about 21 days.
- **Shelves:** Kimberly-Clark stores still hold stock: 1.9% of store-SKUs were out on 7 May, against 1.8% for all brands. No stores are short.

## What we tested
| Hypothesis | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| KC: short deliveries drive the miss | 16 of 20 missed lines short; on-time 96.3% | Confirmed |
| KC: a recent drop | PO lines -0.9 pts; scorecard 94.1% to 89% | Inconclusive |
| KC: our override orders | 54.2% of units short; delivered 99.9% of normal quantity | Confirmed (ours) |
| KC: cuts only took our excess | Only 10.4% of cut units fell below forecast | Confirmed |
| KC: short-shipping not specific to KC | Unit fill 95.4% vs 96.7% for other suppliers | Confirmed (wide) |
| KC: shelves emptying | 1.9% vs 1.8% out of stock | Ruled out |
| Feeding Solutions: whose misses | 5.6% ours | Supplier |
| Feeding Solutions: lead time | 24.6% late, 25.2 days on average | Confirmed |

## What to do
These are recommendations only; I haven't changed anything.
1. **Demand Planning:** Review and retire the overdue Huggies Crawler overrides, which are still active a month past their review date.
2. **Buying:** Take the override-line misses out of Kimberly-Clark's scorecard so the supplier isn't penalised for them.
3. **Supply:** Raise the lateness with Feeding Solutions and look at the 3PL option, at about 21 days instead of 35.
4. **Buying:** Take the misses to the other seven suppliers, which are labelled as theirs, starting with Premium Brands AU and Bugaboo Pacific.
